title: The Floor Will Be Lava
description: Trace light beams through mirrors and splitters to count energized tiles.
writeup:
## Approach

Simulate beam paths through the grid. Each beam has a position and direction. Mirrors (`/`, `\`) reflect the beam, splitters (`|`, `-`) either pass through or split into two beams depending on the beam's direction.

## Part 1

Start a beam at the top-left corner going right. Use BFS with `(row, col, direction)` as state to avoid infinite loops. Count unique `(row, col)` positions visited.

## Part 2

Try every possible edge entry point (all rows from left/right, all columns from top/bottom). Return the maximum number of energized tiles across all starting configurations.
